## Proposed record

Suggested stable ID, record type, display name and whether this is a new entity or a correction to an existing identity.

## What the sources establish

Describe the narrow claim and its limits. Distinguish a reported persona from a verified legal identity and an allegation from a finding.

## Public sources

Source URLs, publishers, publication dates and exact locators or quotations. Identify any sources that repeat the same underlying publication.

## Existing related records

List related IDs and explain which relationships are established, possible or unresolved.

## How this was compiled

State whether the proposal was compiled with the help of AI agents. Only SEAL's analysts designate a profile as curated and created entirely by SEAL's analysts.

Do not include credentials, private correspondence or workstation paths.
